title: Retreat from Laguna
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Retreat from Laguna", at revision 1370706816, opens: "The Retreat from Laguna, also called the Battle of Laguna, was a decisive military engagement fought between the forces of Paraguay and Brazil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q9068360, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1868 withdrawal". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
